title: Gachiakuta
description: Rudo lives in the slums of a floating town, where the poor scrape by under the shadow of the rich who live a sumptuous life, simply casting their garbage off the side, into the abyss. Then one day, he’s falsely accused of murder, and his wrongful conviction leads to an unimaginable punishment—exile off the edge, with the rest of the trash. Down on the surface, the cast-off waste of humanity has bred vicious monsters, and if Rudo wants to have any hope of discovering the truth and seeking vengeance against those who cast him into Hell, he will have to master a new power and join a group known as the Cleaners who battle the hulking trash beasts of the Pit!

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Bullied outcast Rudo finds respite in repurposing trash, until a terrible tragedy changes his life forever.

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Cast into the Pit, Rudo is saved by the mysterious Enjin who may not have his best interests at heart.

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Enjin is a Giver, a being who can give life to things and draw out their power. Ludo, who has also awakened to his power as a Giver, is scouted by Enjin to join an organization called the Cleaners, which fights against the Spotted Beasts born from garbage. Ludo accepts the offer in order to find a way to return to the Heavenly World where he has lived until now, but he suddenly gets into a fight with his trainer, Zanca.

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: After being introduced to Cleaner HQ, Rudo follows Riyo on a job to learn the business.

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: The Cleaners go on a job to save another Sphereite who survived the fall. Rudo tags along to learn more.

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: With the job having gone terribly wrong, Rudo finds himself face to face with a merciless Raider named Jabber.

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Jabber employs a new strategy to get through Rudo's defenses, and another ally joins the fray.

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Rudo deals with the emotional aftermath of the Jabber fight and gets a new lead about returning to the Sphere.

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: With their gear-up complete, the crew heads into the No Man's Land, Penta, to get clues about the Sphere.

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: A mysterious woman living in the No Man's Land challenges the crew from an unexpected angle.

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Tamsy and Zanka fight to save their captive allies. In the aftermath, Rudo has an unexpected reaction.

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Amo tells the story of how she came to the tower and of the "angels" who came to visit her.

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: After returning from the Penta No Man's Land, Rudo and the Cleaners face a series of new threats.

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Taken by the Raiders to an unknown setting, the Cleaners fight for their lives, and Zodyl makes Rudo an offer.

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Bundus interrogates the Santas while Zanka struggles to keep pace with a powered-up Jabber.

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: Zanka reflects on the turning point in his past that brought him to where he is today.

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: While the Raiders-Cleaners conflicts continue, the battle between Riyo and Noerde heats up.

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Zodyl reveals his plan to reach the Sphere, and the other Cleaners react to their current circumstances.

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: As the battle climaxes, Enjin makes a play to unite his team, and Zodyl makes his final entreaty to Rudo.

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: Exiled from his home, Rudo seeks vengeance on those responsible. But first, he must survive a wasteland.

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: Noerde is doing everything he can to prevent the cleaning crew from escaping before they cross the border on the haphazard contraption.

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: As the Cleaners take stock after the battle, a convalescing Zanka receives some surprising news.

episodes_data.title: Gachiakuta Season 1 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: Rudo and the other child Cleaners take a trip to Canvas Town while Corvus entertains some unwanted guests.
